Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.  About Us  Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable. Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry‑first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices. With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search.  We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic. We are backed by top‑notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst, and trusted by 2,000+ customers from high‑growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino’s, and more.  Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman‑founded, women‑led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need.  From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world‑class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.  Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting‑edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.  Messaging Operations Manager  We are looking for a dynamic and experienced individual to join Insider One and support our Revenue Operations team as a Messaging Operations Manager, specifically focusing on our messaging and WhatsApp products. In this role, you will play a crucial part in driving profits, optimizing deal execution, and managing vendor negotiations. You will be responsible for pricing checks, negotiating special pricing with vendors, and collaborating closely with the sales team to ensure smooth deal execution. Your expertise in vendor management and pricing will be vital for the success of the messaging and WhatsApp product lines.  Additionally, you will drive process enhancements and ensure that our pricing and deal structuring align with the company’s overall goals. Your negotiation skills will help maintain a seamless process from quoting to deal closure, while ensuring compliance with both internal policies and external regulations.  What You Will Do   Vendor Negotiation and Pricing Management   Lead pricing checks and negotiate special pricing with SMS and WhatsApp vendors.  Secure competitive pricing from vendors, ensuring profitability and operational efficiency.  Work closely with the sales team to collaborate on pricing, deal structuring, and contract terms.  Manage vendor relationships to maintain favorable terms and high service levels.  Deal Execution and Rev Ops Collaboration   Support the Revenue Operations team in driving profitability and optimizing deal execution.  Ensure compliance with internal booking policies and external regulations during deal structuring.  Collaborate with sales teams and other key stakeholders to ensure smooth deal execution.  Assist in onboarding new sales reps and providing training on quoting tools and CRM systems.  Operational Efficiency and Process Enhancements   Implement and manage dashboards or reporting tools to monitor deal performance, pricing efficiency, and vendor relationships.  Drive process improvements that enhance the team’s scalability and efficiency.  Monitor key metrics related to pricing performance, deal closure rates, and vendor management.  Market & Trend Analysis   Analyze market trends to ensure that pricing remains competitive across different regions.  Provide insights on SMS and WhatsApp pricing dynamics to inform strategic decisions.  Stay up to date on industry benchmarks to ensure Insider One maintains its competitive edge.    What You Will Need   2-8 years of experience in deal desk operations, pricing, or related areas.  Strong negotiation and people skills with a proven track record of vendor management.  Familiarity with CRM systems and quoting tools.  Experience with messaging and WhatsApp products is a plus.  Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.  Ability to work cross‑functionally and manage multiple stakeholders.  Comfortable in a fast‑paced environment, capable of managing tight deadlines.    What We Offer   Be part of a diverse team that’s as global as it gets — where every voice is heard and 50+ nationalities build together.  Level up with internal trainings covering AI fundamentals, coding, foreign languages, and a wide range of personal development skills.  Feed your curiosity with access to Spotify, LinkedIn Learning, Blinkist, MasterClass, and CloudGuru.  Become a Shareowner through our eligibility‑based "ESOP" and own a piece of what you build.  Help build the team you want to work with and enjoy rewarding referral bonuses.  Opportunities to give back to your community through volunteering and purpose‑driven social impact projects.  From global retreats to team‑building activities, expect year‑round events that turn into lifelong memories.    We aren't just hiring for a position; we are hiring for a mission — a mission to build a lasting legacy that will set the benchmark for the most progressive tech companies out there.  To do this, we are looking for exceptional talent to join a community of good-hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile.  If this sounds like who you are and where you aspire to be, we are excited to meet you.  We provide equal opportunity in a zero‑discrimination workplace and not just welcome but also embrace everyone without regard to sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status.  Please follow Insider One on LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook and Medium!   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Com nossa crença principal: “Ajudamos as pessoas a comer melhor, a viver melhor”, estamos levando a inovação para o cenário global!  Responsabilidades   Formação e capacitação de equipes  : Ajudar a Keeta a estabelecer uma equipe de vendas de entrega de alimentos em novas cidades, começando do zero para impulsionar a expansão dos negócios. Por meio de modelos sistemáticos de treinamento e capacitação individual ou em grupo, aprimore rapidamente os recursos da equipe e garanta o cumprimento das metas comerciais.  Desenvolvimento e otimização de sistemas  : estabeleça e mantenha canais de comunicação fluidos dentro e fora da equipe. Otimize continuamente os mecanismos operacionais da equipe com base nas diferentes fases de desenvolvimento dos negócios para fortalecer a experiência profissional da equipe.  Integração cultural e formação de equipes  : demonstre a capacidade de gerenciar equipes multiculturais com eficácia e formar uma equipe de alto desempenho que se alinhe aos valores fundamentais da empresa.  Definição e alinhamento de metas  : Combine os requisitos da liderança sênior com a situação real da equipe, realize avaliações abrangentes e forneça feedback, esclareça os objetivos do trabalho e defina metas em fases de acordo com os cronogramas.  Gerenciamento e acompanhamento de processos  : utilize uma estrutura madura de procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOP) para garantir operações tranquilas na linha de frente. Ajuste prontamente as estratégias com base no progresso dos negócios para garantir que o gerenciamento de processos atenda aos requisitos.  Obtenção e revisão de resultados  : garanta que os objetivos de trabalho sejam alcançados com sucesso. Realize revisões dos processos de trabalho, explore métodos mais eficientes, resuma experiências e acumule percepções valiosas para trabalhos futuros.  Gerenciamento e otimização do tempo  : defina claramente as prioridades de gerenciamento do tempo para a função e os diferentes níveis e otimize o gerenciamento do tempo pessoal com base nas circunstâncias reais.  Experiência em gerenciamento  : tem experiência em gerenciamento de equipes de vendas, com desempenho excepcional em outra empresa no último ano.  Métodos de liderança de equipes  : capacidade de articular claramente métodos para liderar equipes para o sucesso, com experiência comprovada e replicável em mercados estrangeiros.  Compartilhamento de experiências  : compartilhe ativamente experiências de trabalho e forneça sugestões de melhorias práticas para ajudar a equipe a aprimorar rapidamente suas capacidades.  Pensamento estratégico  : possua uma mentalidade holística com a capacidade de planejar claramente os caminhos de desenvolvimento dos negócios e da equipe. Ao enfrentar desafios, identifique com precisão as causas básicas e coordene a sede e as várias equipes para resolver os problemas rapidamente.  Foco no desenvolvimento de talentos  : Priorize o crescimento de talentos, tendo atuado anteriormente como instrutor corporativo ou estabelecido um sistema de treinamento dentro da equipe.  Motivação e resiliência  : demonstrar forte ambição e profissionalismo, disposição para se desafiar e capacidade de lidar com pressões relacionadas ao trabalho de forma eficaz.  Proficiência em idiomas  : Fluente em inglês e português (fala, audição, leitura e escrita), com capacidade de adaptação a trabalhos e viagens de longo prazo no exterior.    Destaques do trabalho  Junte-se a nós para testemunhar o rápido crescimento do negócio global de entrega de alimentos da Meituan e vivenciar em primeira mão a transformação do setor e os milagres do crescimento. Você colaborará com uma equipe diversificada e de classe mundial, promovendo o pensamento inovador, expandindo sua perspectiva internacional e aprofundando sua experiência. Não se trata apenas de um emprego, mas de uma oportunidade inigualável de crescimento pessoal, de valorização pessoal e de inovação empresarial global.   #J-18808-Ljbffr
